paite: TOUPA phat un! TOUPA pahtawi in la thak sa unla, misiangthoute kikhopna ah aphatna la sa un.
heading: Israelte Tung A Pathian Hoihna Phatna La

paite: Israelte amau siampa tung ah kipak uhenla; Zion tate akumpipa uh tung ah nuam uhen.
Amin lou in phat uhenla; khuangta leh kaihging toh amah phat in la sa uhen.
TOUPA amite tung ah akipak a; thunuailutte hotdamna in azem ding hi.
Misiangthoute thupina ah kipaktak in om uhenla; alupna tungte uah nuam in la sa uhen!
Pathian pahtawi a phatna akam uah om henla, akhut uah namsau hiamtuah om hen.
Namte tung a phu la a, michih tung a gawtna tungsak ding leh,
akumpipate uh khainiang a hen a, amihoihte uh sikkolte bunsak ding leh,
atung ua vaihawm gelhsa tungsak ding in; huai kilawmna a misiangthou tengteng in anei chiat uhi, TOUPA phat un!
